page.layout: One page of text, with a running head at the top. Below the running head: a poem with two headings ("IN EVNDEM,", "IN EVNDEM.") and a large heading block "IN ARCHIEPISCOPVM ... primarium," set in a larger type, followed by a poem beginning with an enlarged R initial. No marginal notes. Right margin is empty except for show-through. Page number 122 at top left of the running head.

main_text.l: Sic valido curas semper solatur Iaccho,
Qui præsens illi Spiritus unus adest.
Atque illum solita subdere fraude putas.
Qua vos Pontifices censuit esse Deos.
Nunc vestri patuere doli: nunc monstrat Æsellus-
Si tua quos clauis, præsul Romane, ligarat-
Te veram cæli clauem gestare negamus.
Romulæ sedis sceleri si danda potestas,
Cur te neglexit Patrum venerabilis ordo?
Cur te pontificem noluit esse suum?

page.notes: The Æsellus / Auriculas line and the Leo line are printed with a long-s-free italic; "Æsellus" and "Æ" appear as printed. Line "Nunc vestri patuere doli: nunc monstrat" is set with a colon after "doli" as printed. The heading "IN ARCHIEPISCOPVM" is set in spaced capitals across the full measure and is the title of the epigram beginning "QVENDAM" on the next lines. The enlarged R at the start of "Romulæ" is a woodcut-style initial. The last word "Cur" at the right edge is a catchword. Lines of the first poem are italic; "Sic" line is also italic. Some letters are slightly unclear due to print and scan quality; no [?] markers were required for the legible text. Right-margin show-through of text from the reverse page is ignored.
